name: Beko KDVC90X — 90cm Range Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Beko KDVC90X is a 90cm electric range cooker in stainless steel — two fan ovens plus a separate grill give a huge 167-litre combined capacity, ideal for bigger families and batch cooking. Its five-zone ceramic hob has Rapilite fast-heat zones and wipes clean easily, over a grease-proof enamel interior. A/A energy rated.
features: Two fan ovens plus a separate grill — 167L combined
Five-zone ceramic hob with Rapilite fast heat
Extra width for larger pots and pans
